description: This header file declares functions and structures related to interactive rebasing, specifically handling todo lists and replay options in a version control system (likely Git).

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Appends help information for todo commands, providing command count, revision identifiers, and buffer.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Allows editing of the todo list within a repository context, considering replay options and flags.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the consistency or validity of a todo list against another todo list.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Checks the current todo list against a backup, ensuring consistency within the repository and replay options context.
